messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

Wi-Fi 7 pushes SG/SA capability toward 320 MHz WLAN bandwidth, 4096QAM, up to 16 spatial streams and MLO, while Wi‑Fi 8 keeps the same cited core PHY parameters—up to 7.125 GHz, up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO—but adds UHR-oriented PHY/MAC test items such as dRU and unequal modulation per MIMO link.[12][2][1][6]
| Area | Effect on SG/SA measurement capability |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 requires coverage of 320 MHz channel bandwidth, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth.[12][2] A 480 MHz WLAN waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 bandwidth, but it implies early R&D setups may need near-500 MHz waveform verification capability when evaluating candidate waveforms.[5][6] CMP180 is cited with IF bandwidth 250 MHz, or 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185, and WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator/analyzer performance is specified for 320 MHz signals.[36][35] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 7 uses 4096QAM, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining 4096QAM.[12][2] Therefore, residual EVM of both generator and analyzer becomes a key capability: CMP180 WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer EVM is specified at 320 MHz as < –46 dB measured, or < –48 dB with R&S CMP-KB805, while the WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator is specified at 320 MHz as < –43 dB.[35] In Wi‑Fi-over-mmWave test needs, TX analysis explicitly includes EVM under Wi‑Fi 7 modulation.[21] |
| MIMO / multi-link | Wi‑Fi 7 includes up to 16 spatial streams and MLO, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining MLO.[12][2] Wi‑Fi 8 adds unequal modulation, where each MIMO link can use a different modulation scheme in difficult reception scenarios, so analysis must evaluate whether the device adapts modulation according to specified MCS combinations.[1] Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing specifically says MLO makes a test environment with multiple RF chains crucial, and listed Wi‑Fi 7 tests include 2x2 MIMO.[11] CMP180 is described as integrating two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, with two instruments scalable to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[10] |
| Spectrum / frequency range | Wi‑Fi 8’s cited core frequency support is up to 7.125 GHz, and Wi‑Fi 7 testing includes the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery.[2][11] CMP180 is specified up to 8 GHz, or 8.25 GHz RX overrange with the relevant option combination, and requires R&S CMP-K168 for 6 GHz to 8 GHz operation.[36] For Wi‑Fi over mmWave, sources describe Wi‑Fi 7 signals being up-converted through AiP modules to a 27 GHz mmWave band, with n257/n258 referenced, and the test needs include occupied bandwidth, ACLR, EIRP, TRP, EIS and Rx/OOB spurious emissions.[22][23][21] CMP200/CMPHEAD50 are cited for mmWave signal generation/analysis in that WoMT setup, and CMPHEAD50 covers 21.84 GHz to 50.20 GHz.[21][56] FSW67 covers 2 Hz to 67 GHz and has analysis-bandwidth options including 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz and 2 GHz.[59][60] |
| Test scenarios | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D measurements must be performed in signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics.[11] Production-phase WLAN RF measurements are described as non-signaling to save time.[10] OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode testing under realistic multipath RF conditions for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points.[19] Wi‑Fi 7-specific R&D tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities.[11] Interworking scenarios include WLAN offloading and Voice over WLAN handover between cellular and WLAN, with POLQA voice-quality measurement for early QoE assessment.[14] |
【推論】For sub-8 GHz Wi‑Fi 7/8 SG/SA, the practical baseline moves to 320 MHz waveform generation/analysis, low-EVM 4096QAM handling, 6/7.125 GHz frequency coverage, and multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO operation, based on the cited Wi‑Fi 7/8 PHY parameters and the cited WLAN 802.11be measurement capabilities.[12][2][35][36][10][11]
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8 R&D, the SG/SA workload is not only higher throughput PHY validation but also reliability-oriented feature validation such as dRU and UEQM, because the cited Wi‑Fi 8 positioning shifts toward UHR connectivity and names dRU/UEQM as added or emphasized PHY/MAC technologies.[6][1]
【推論】For advanced or nonstandard extensions such as Wi‑Fi over mmWave, SG/SA capability must expand from native Wi‑Fi IF/IB testing into OTA/mmWave generation, analysis and spectrum measurements around the cited 27 GHz / n257 / n258 path, while noting that the WoMT sources are project decks rather than formal standards.[21][22][23][24]

| MIMO / multi-link | Wi‑Fi 7 includes up to 16 spatial streams and MLO, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining MLO.[12][2] Wi‑Fi 8 adds unequal modulation, where each MIMO link can use a different modulation scheme in difficult reception scenarios, so analysis must evaluate whether the device adapts modulation according to specified MCS combinations.[1] Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing specifically says MLO makes a test environment with multiple RF chains crucial, and listed Wi‑Fi 7 tests include 2x2 MIMO.[11] CMP180 is described as integrating two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, with two instruments scalable to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[10] |
| Spectrum / frequency range | Wi‑Fi 8’s cited core frequency support is up to 7.125 GHz, and Wi‑Fi 7 testing includes the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery.[2][11] CMP180 is specified up to 8 GHz, or 8.25 GHz RX overrange with the relevant option combination, and requires R&S CMP-K168 for 6 GHz to 8 GHz operation.[36] For Wi‑Fi over mmWave, sources describe Wi‑Fi 7 signals being up-converted through AiP modules to a 27 GHz mmWave band, with n257/n258 referenced, and the test needs include occupied bandwidth, ACLR, EIRP, TRP, EIS and Rx/OOB spurious emissions.[22][23][21] CMP200/CMPHEAD50 are cited for mmWave signal generation/analysis in that WoMT setup, and CMPHEAD50 covers 21.84 GHz to 50.20 GHz.[21][56] FSW67 covers 2 Hz to 67 GHz and has analysis-bandwidth options including 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz and 2 GHz.[59][60] |
| Test scenarios | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D measurements must be performed in signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics.[11] Production-phase WLAN RF measurements are described as non-signaling to save time.[10] OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode testing under realistic multipath RF conditions for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points.[19] Wi‑Fi 7-specific R&D tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities.[11] Interworking scenarios include WLAN offloading and Voice over WLAN handover between cellular and WLAN, with POLQA voice-quality measurement for early QoE assessment.[14] |
【推論】For sub-8 GHz Wi‑Fi 7/8 SG/SA, the practical baseline moves to 320 MHz waveform generation/analysis, low-EVM 4096QAM handling, 6/7.125 GHz frequency coverage, and multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO operation, based on the cited Wi‑Fi 7/8 PHY parameters and the cited WLAN 802.11be measurement capabilities.[12][2][35][36][10][11]
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8 R&D, the SG/SA workload is not only higher throughput PHY validation but also reliability-oriented feature validation such as dRU and UEQM, because the cited Wi‑Fi 8 positioning shifts toward UHR connectivity and names dRU/UEQM as added or emphasized PHY/MAC technologies.[6][1]
【推論】For advanced or nonstandard extensions such as Wi‑Fi over mmWave, SG/SA capability must expand from native Wi‑Fi IF/IB testing into OTA/mmWave generation, analysis and spectrum measurements around the cited 27 GHz / n257 / n258 path, while noting that the WoMT sources are project decks rather than formal standards.[21][22][23][24]

answer.question: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer? Include implications for bandwidth, modulation/EVM, MIMO/multi-link, spectrum/frequency range, and test scenarios.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 使用限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]、[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 與 [[WiFi8]] 支撐。
- [[WiFi8]] 是 OneNote link hub，不是文章正文、datasheet、configuration guide、IEEE standard text 或 certification document。
- PR / demonstration statement 不等同於 IEEE standard text、datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification document。
- 來源未標示 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] draft version、standard version、final ratification date 或 IEEE document number。
- 來源未列出完整 [[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY / MAC feature set、band plan、regulatory conditions、test requirements 或 interoperability criteria。
- 480 MHz waveform 僅能記為 MWC 2024 PR 中的 potential candidate，不可寫成 Wi-Fi 8 正式規格。
- 320 MHz channel bandwidth 僅能記為較晚 R&S / Broadcom PR 對 retained core PHY parameter 的說法，不可替代 IEEE 802.11bn 正式文件。
- 不可從 [[WiFi8]] 的連結標題推論 [[Broadcom]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[ASUS]] 或 [[Filogic 8000]] 的產品規格、上市時間、供應關係或認證狀態。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 8 › CES 2026 外部待讀連結
[[WiFi8]]（raw converted 2026-09-17）是 OneNote link hub，列出與 [[CES 2026]]、[[Broadcom]]、[[ASUS]]、[[MediaTek]]、[[Filogic 8000]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 相關的外部文章連結。該來源只提供連結標題與 URL，未擷取正文，因此目前只能支撐 [[Wi-Fi 8 外部資料清單]]，不能作為標準內容、晶片規格、路由器展示或量產時程的證據。

可追溯的連結線索包括：

- Tom's Hardware 標題提到 [[Broadcom]] two dual-band [[Wi-Fi 8]] chips。
- TechNews / The Verge 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] router / CES before most users have switched to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- RCR Wireless 標題提到 [[MediaTek]] previews [[Filogic 8000]] at [[CES 2026]]。
- EDN 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] silicon 與 AI touch。
- Network World 標題提到 [[Wi-Fi 8]] prioritizes reliability over speed gains。

以上均為待讀線索，不新增本頁的技術規格主張。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。

Wi-Fi 7 pushes SG/SA capability toward 320 MHz WLAN bandwidth, 4096QAM, up to 16 spatial streams and MLO, while Wi‑Fi 8 keeps the same cited core PHY parameters—up to 7.125 GHz, up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO—but adds UHR-oriented PHY/MAC test items such as dRU and unequal modulation per MIMO link.[12][2][1][6]
| Area | Effect on SG/SA measurement capability |
|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 requires coverage of 320 MHz channel bandwidth, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth.[12][2] A 480 MHz WLAN waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 bandwidth, but it implies early R&D setups may need near-500 MHz waveform verification capability when evaluating candidate waveforms.[5][6] CMP180 is cited with IF bandwidth 250 MHz, or 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185, and WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator/analyzer performance is specified for 320 MHz signals.[36][35] |
| Modulation / EVM | Wi‑Fi 7 uses 4096QAM, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining 4096QAM.[12][2] Therefore, residual EVM of both generator and analyzer becomes a key capability: CMP180 WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer EVM is specified at 320 MHz as < –46 dB measured, or < –48 dB with R&S CMP-KB805, while the WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator is specified at 320 MHz as < –43 dB.[35] In Wi‑Fi-over-mmWave test needs, TX analysis explicitly includes EVM under Wi‑Fi 7 modulation.[21] |
| MIMO / multi-link | Wi‑Fi 7 includes up to 16 spatial streams and MLO, and Wi‑Fi 8 is cited as retaining MLO.[12][2] Wi‑Fi 8 adds unequal modulation, where each MIMO link can use a different modulation scheme in difficult reception scenarios, so analysis must evaluate whether the device adapts modulation according to specified MCS combinations.[1] Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing specifically says MLO makes a test environment with multiple RF chains crucial, and listed Wi‑Fi 7 tests include 2x2 MIMO.[11] CMP180 is described as integrating two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, with two instruments scalable to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[10] |
| Spectrum / frequency range | Wi‑Fi 8’s cited core frequency support is up to 7.125 GHz, and Wi‑Fi 7 testing includes the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery.[2][11] CMP180 is specified up to 8 GHz, or 8.25 GHz RX overrange with the relevant option combination, and requires R&S CMP-K168 for 6 GHz to 8 GHz operation.[36] For Wi‑Fi over mmWave, sources describe Wi‑Fi 7 signals being up-converted through AiP modules to a 27 GHz mmWave band, with n257/n258 referenced, and the test needs include occupied bandwidth, ACLR, EIRP, TRP, EIS and Rx/OOB spurious emissions.[22][23][21] CMP200/CMPHEAD50 are cited for mmWave signal generation/analysis in that WoMT setup, and CMPHEAD50 covers 21.84 GHz to 50.20 GHz.[21][56] FSW67 covers 2 Hz to 67 GHz and has analysis-bandwidth options including 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz and 2 GHz.[59][60] |
| Test scenarios | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D measurements must be performed in signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics.[11] Production-phase WLAN RF measurements are described as non-signaling to save time.[10] OTA MIMO stress testing is described as over-the-air, signaling-mode testing under realistic multipath RF conditions for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points.[19] Wi‑Fi 7-specific R&D tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities.[11] Interworking scenarios include WLAN offloading and Voice over WLAN handover between cellular and WLAN, with POLQA voice-quality measurement for early QoE assessment.[14] |
【推論】For sub-8 GHz Wi‑Fi 7/8 SG/SA, the practical baseline moves to 320 MHz waveform generation/analysis, low-EVM 4096QAM handling, 6/7.125 GHz frequency coverage, and multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO operation, based on the cited Wi‑Fi 7/8 PHY parameters and the cited WLAN 802.11be measurement capabilities.[12][2][35][36][10][11]
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8 R&D, the SG/SA workload is not only higher throughput PHY validation but also reliability-oriented feature validation such as dRU and UEQM, because the cited Wi‑Fi 8 positioning shifts toward UHR connectivity and names dRU/UEQM as added or emphasized PHY/MAC technologies.[6][1]
【推論】For advanced or nonstandard extensions such as Wi‑Fi over mmWave, SG/SA capability must expand from native Wi‑Fi IF/IB testing into OTA/mmWave generation, analysis and spectrum measurements around the cited 27 GHz / n257 / n258 path, while noting that the WoMT sources are project decks rather than formal standards.[21][22][23][24]

cited_passages.text:
Wi-Fi 8 › 新增 / 強調的 PHY 與 MAC layer technologies
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 舉例列出：

- [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）：用於 overcome power spectral density（PSD）limits；dRU measurements 可驗證 uplink transmit power boost 與 connection reliability improvement。
- [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）：在 difficult reception scenarios 中允許 each [[MIMO]] link 使用 different modulation scheme；UEQM analysis 可評估 device 是否依 specified MCS combinations 正確 adapt modulation。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 架構與用途
來源中的 WoMT 架構可整理為：

1. 產生或處理 native [[Wi-Fi 7]] / IEEE 802.11be signal。
2. 透過 [[AiP]] / antenna-in-package module 執行 integrated antenna 與 up-conversion。
3. 將信號搬移到 27 GHz mmWave band，來源以 n257 / n258 表示。
4. 用於 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP。
5. 在 RD / manufacturing setup 中分成 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave path。
6. 透過 OTA / RF test 確認 EVM、[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、[[EIS]]、occupied bandwidth 與 Rx / OOB spurious emissions。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 來源定義
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]：

- WoMT project 的完整描述出現在 slide 1：`Technical Achievements and Measurement Results for JIO WoMT Project`。
- Slide 3 說核心問題是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 原生運作於 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz，而 27 GHz、n257 / n258 屬 [[3GPP]] mmWave bands。
- Slide 3 說目前缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的 established global test standards。
- Slide 4 說 transmission principle 是透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 Wi-Fi 7 signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band。
- Slide 4 說 device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP（Access Point）。
- Slide 8 提到 test basis 為 `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)`。

依 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]：

- 來源未重新定義 WoMT，但在 Jio project RD and manufacturing setup 中明確分出 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被放在 WIFI IB band / native Wi-Fi testing path。
- [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 被放在 WIFI mmWave path。
- RD site 以 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSW67]]、[[R&S SMM100A]] 做 Tx / Rx measurement。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 使用限制
- [[Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology]] 目前不是由正式標準文件建立的 concept；本頁只反映 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] 的 project-deck 說法。
- `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)` 的版本、發布組織、適用地區、測試項目與認證流程未標示。
- 27 GHz 與 n257 / n258 的關係在來源中未以頻段表定義；不可自行補入 3GPP band tables。
- 來源沒有提供 throughput、range、modulation coding scheme、channel bandwidth、EIRP limit、TRP limit、EIS limit 或 spurious limit 數值。
- Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP 未提供產品型號、供應商、ODM 完整名稱或商用狀態。
- [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]] 的 RD / manufacturing setup 是方案圖與 appendix，不能當作正式 BOM 或 test procedure。
